MeshCore — Experimental

Exchange road reports over a MeshCore LoRa radio, with or without internet. Anyone in radio range can read what is sent: position, time and the public key that signed it. It is neither private nor anonymous. A valid signature proves which key signed a report, not that the report is true. Not tested on real radios yet.

Transmit by radio?

What goes out on the radio can be received by anyone in range, with or without internet: the position of the report, its time and the public key that signed it (yours). It is not anonymous.

The bridges also pass other people's reports between the radio and the Nostr relays, always with their original author. A valid signature proves the key, not that the report is true.

You can switch every radio feature off at any time, and clear what is waiting to be published.
